items.description: The report gives inconsistent low-offset bounds: the title/impact state offset18 < 1e9 while the truncation mechanism requires OFFSET18 < 1e18; the plan uses the stated < 1e9 and both readings imply the same stored OFFSET of 0.

It is not fully specified whether every full-withdrawal amount underflows or only specific amounts; the report asserts the revert occurs deterministically, so the revert predicate is taken to hold for the full-withdrawal path generally.
